newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PdVSA paid $10 bln to Venezuela treasury in 96.
newsitem.headline: PdVSA paid $10 bln to Venezuela treasury in 96.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA contributed some $10 billion to the national treasury last year, almost double its payments in 1995, PdVSA president Luis Giusti said.
"That's equivalent to around 14 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), the highest in recent memory," Giusti told reporters before speaking at the Congressional Environmental Commission.
"It's the fruit of a policy that stresses (production) volume over prices," he added.
Venezuela aims to increase its crude production by some 10 percent a year to take advantage of world demand seen growing at between one and two percent annually.
The country produced 3.17 million barrels per day (bpd) in February, according to a Reuters survey.
Giusti added an era of low prices and low inventories "had arrived to stay", which would strengthen Venezuela's position as a reliable hemispheric producer.
